rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese term for a road van carrying goods or passengers.

example.english: This van can carry eight people.
example.traditional: 呢架客貨車可以坐八個人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 haak3 fo3 ce1 ho2 ji5 zo6 baat3 go3 jan4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an enclosed freight vehicle running on a railway.

example.english: This railway van is full of freight.
example.traditional: 呢架鐵路貨卡入面全部都係貨。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 tit3 lou6 fo3 kaat1 jap6 min6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 fo3

rows.note: Use this for a mobile vehicle fitted out to carry out repairs at sites where structures cannot be moved.

example.english: The repair crew uses a van to fix the bridge on site.
example.traditional: 工程隊用流動維修車去現場整橋。
example.jyutping: gung1 cing4 deoi6 jung6 lau4 dung6 wai4 sau1 ce1 heoi3 jin6 coeng4 zing2 kiu4
